elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting the other party’s employees or personnel.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides that “neither party will solicit” covered employees, so Customer remains bound.

elements.element: The employee non-solicitation restriction is mutual and applies equally to both parties.
elements.evidence: The restriction applies to “neither party” soliciting a person employed by “the other party.”

elements.element: Covered personnel are limited to personnel directly involved in the services.
elements.evidence: Coverage is limited to employees “directly involved in the performance or receipt of the activities contemplated by this Agreement,” which limits the restriction to personnel directly involved in the parties’ contractual activities.

elements.element: The restriction applies during each covered individual’s involvement and for no more than 12 months after that individual’s involvement ends.
elements.evidence: The clause states that the restriction “shall in no event extend beyond twelve (12) months after the end of such individual's involvement.” Read with the direct-involvement limitation, an individual is not covered before becoming involved.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from solicitation.
elements.evidence: “Solicit” expressly excludes “generally advertising job openings” and follow-up with individuals responding to those advertisements.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by personnel are excluded from solicitation.
elements.evidence: “Solicit” expressly excludes follow-up with individuals “who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries.”

elements.element: The clause does not impose a no-hire restriction.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition addresses solicitation rather than hiring, and the clause confirms that it does not prohibit employing or engaging a person who was not solicited in breach.

result.reason: The redline does not achieve the preferred position because Customer remains subject to a non-solicit. It achieves the fallback by making the obligation mutual, limiting covered employees to directly involved personnel, capping the restriction at 12 months after each individual’s involvement ends, retaining the required carve-outs, and avoiding a standalone no-hire prohibition. The changes are confined to the non-solicitation provision and preserve unrelated terms. Drafting quality is reduced by the dual duration formulation—an Agreement-expiration period plus an individual-involvement cap—which is less direct than stating the restriction runs during involvement and for 12 months thereafter; “activities contemplated by this Agreement” is also less precise than “services,” and “For purpose” is grammatically defective.
